svg.title: Harting — review study
svg.desc: Original WireNexus thumbnail compared visually; existing SVG inspected at 32, 64 and 128 px. Existing male/female 64-contact source studies preserve their true 111:27 aspect ratio. Han D64 reference confirms a real 64-contact family exists. IMPORTANT source conflict: original Harting.png shows a different, unidentified insert. Retained reviewed 64-contact study is a documented family example, not a verified match to that thumbnail. Housing, PE and pin mapping need precise part identity.
